name: poneglyph
description: Local marketplace for the mods that live in this repository.

plugins.name: workboard
plugins.description: Ticket, changes, evidence, agents and decisions inside Claude Code. Agentic OS is optional.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Stats bar above the prompt with model, effort, context, plan limits, cache countdown and cost, plus thumbnails of pasted images.

plugins.name: vista
plugins.description: Interactive answers in the transcript: a comparison with clickable topics, a ranking with thumbnails and a draft with Copiar.

plugins.name: dock
plugins.description: Action buttons in the transcript: open a file, a folder, a terminal, an agent session, a URL or Finder; through Agentic OS when it runs, macOS apps otherwise.
